items.headline: Brazil votes in presidential runoff
items.summary: Brazilians vote Sunday in a runoff between President Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro that could decide whether the country keeps left-wing leadership or shifts right. Supporters of Lula's Workers' Party spent the final days rallying votes.

items.headline: Gunmen kill 7 at church funeral in Jordan
items.summary: Three gunmen opened fire on a Greek Orthodox church in Karak during a funeral on Friday, killing seven people and wounding 40. Footage of the attack was broadcast on Jordanian state television.

items.headline: Kim Jong Un visits China to open bridge
items.summary: North Korea's leader is in China to inaugurate a new cross-border bridge, his first trip there in a year. The visit comes as Pyongyang seeks closer alignment with Beijing and Moscow.

items.headline: Trump invokes Defense Production Act for oil
items.summary: President Trump invoked the Defense Production Act to boost U.S. oil, gas and diesel production. The order covers oil, gas and diesel output.

items.headline: Millions of seniors face Medicare Advantage changes
items.summary: As many as 5 million seniors may need to choose a new plan as insurers cut or exit some Medicare Advantage markets. Open enrollment runs through Dec. 7.

items.headline: USDA presses ahead with Forest Service overhaul
items.summary: Agriculture Secretary Rollins said the department is moving "full-bore ahead" on reorganizing the Forest Service. The plan would move its headquarters to Salt Lake City, close 23 research stations and replace many regional offices.

items.headline: Watchdog: Pentagon skirts its own AI rules
items.summary: A congressional watchdog report found that Pentagon weapons and projects with AI capabilities do not always follow the department's responsible-AI guidelines. The report was issued by a watchdog that reports to Congress.

items.headline: U.N.: world on track for 2.8C of warming
items.summary: A new U.N. emissions gap report says current climate policies put the world on course for 2.8 degrees Celsius of warming this century. The assessment is based on policies currently in place.

items.headline: India's voter-roll purge stirs protests
items.summary: Protests have spread over India's revision of its voter rolls. Critics fear millions of marginalized voters are being disenfranchised.

items.headline: Diesel prices weigh on Iowa races
items.summary: Record-high diesel prices are hitting Iowa's farm economy. The costs could shape the state's competitive governor and Senate races, where incumbents are retiring.

digest.overview:
President Trump cast his midterm ballot early in West Palm Beach on Saturday, saying he voted for all Republicans in Florida, before heading to a rally in Georgia. Former President Barack Obama, campaigning for Democrats, cast Trump as an agent of "chaos and cruelty." Trump invoked the Defense Production Act to boost oil, gas and diesel production, as record diesel prices weigh on Iowa's competitive governor and Senate races. As many as 5 million seniors may need new coverage as some Medicare Advantage plans end, with open enrollment running through Dec. 7. The Agriculture Department is pressing ahead with a Forest Service overhaul that would move its headquarters to Salt Lake City and close 23 research stations. A congressional watchdog found the Pentagon does not always follow its own responsible-AI guidelines.

Abroad, Brazilians vote Sunday in a presidential runoff between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro that will decide whether the country keeps left-wing leadership or shifts right. Gunmen opened fire on a Greek Orthodox church in Karak, Jordan, during a funeral, killing seven people and wounding 40. North Korean leader Kim Jong Un traveled to China to inaugurate a new cross-border bridge, his first trip there in a year, as Pyongyang seeks closer alignment with Beijing and Moscow. In India, protests over a revision of voter rolls reflect fears that millions of marginalized voters could be disenfranchised. A new U.N. report says current climate policies put the world on course for 2.8 degrees Celsius of warming this century.

home.overview:
The Brewers are two wins from their first championship after storming back from a 4–0 first-inning hole to beat the Rays 5–4 in World Series Game 2. Sal Frelick's sixth-inning homer tied it, Cooper Pratt's seventh-inning single won it, and the game ended on a disputed check-swing strikeout of Yandy Díaz; Game 3 is Monday in Tampa Bay. In the NBA, the Spurs got their first win, 122–106 at Dallas, Denver outlasted New Orleans 141–135 in overtime, and the Heat fell to 0–3 in Charlotte. NFL Week 7 kicks off with Steelers–Saints in Paris, Lamar Jackson ruled out for Baltimore against Cincinnati, and Chiefs at Seahawks on Sunday night.

Aston Villa ended Man City's perfect start with a 2–1 win, Arsenal pulled level on 21 points by beating Everton 2–0, and Tottenham won 2–0 at Chelsea. Liverpool host Brighton today, and Barcelona welcome Real Madrid for El Clásico after Atlético closed to within two points. Dortmund went top of the Bundesliga with a 1–0 win over Frankfurt as Bayern visit Freiburg, and QPR routed Swansea 5–0 in the Championship. PSG host Lyon on Monday. In the KBO, rain pushed Kia–Samsung Game 1 to Monday night.

The series moves to Tampa Bay's Tropicana Field for Game 3 on Monday night.
